invariants: expected work is recomputed from canonical validation policies rather than copied into this policy
selected symbolic checks groups and requirements are compared as exact sets
stage invocation counts must exactly match canonical single-pass counts
pytest is required exactly when at least one T2 group is selected
full suite network T3 execution and T4 execution are never expected inside incremental validation
extra work is overvalidation and missing required work is undervalidation
detector is pure standard-library logic and executes no validation command
